content: q17. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (memo CRUD mutations/queries — `useCreateMemo`/`useUpdateMemo`/`useDeleteMemo`/list & detail queries via `memoKeys`, e.g. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:1-20`); it uses `memoServiceClient`, the generated Connect-RPC client for `MemoService` created at `web/src/connect.ts:197` (`memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, with `MemoService` imported from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`).
